label: Cogburns Fooocus (mashb1t)
notice: Modified copies of files from mashb1t/Fooocus (GPL-3.0, https://github.com/mashb1t/Fooocus) at the commit above. This is Cogburns Fooocus. Changes: an always-on block for prompts combining minors with sexual content, a family_safety.lock file that forces Black Out NSFW on, blocks the models in family_models.json, logs prompts to family_activity.jsonl and turns off --share/--listen, 1080p/2K/4K/8K sizes, and a fix so the Enhance-tab Upscale/Vary cleans up the picture the same way as the large aspect ratios (process_enhance now runs upscale_with_detail and re-saves at the upscaled resolution).
